liebermann.description_de: Mag. Sinicius camerarius pape (Liber censuum eccl. Rom.)
liebermann.shelfmark_as_given: The Liber censuum of the Roman Church (sentences brought by Master Sinicius, papal chamberlain, 1267)
liebermann.notes: Master Sinicius, papal chamberlain and nuncio in England, brought to the Curia in 1267 sentences on Peter's Pence from Instituta Cnuti (Ip Hunt class: I Cn Pr., 11) and ECf 10; they stand in the Liber censuum of the Roman church, in Vatican MS Christina reg. 451 (17th century) and in Vc.
